notes: Fixes Market and Chrome Manager opening on a hidden off-roster actor (e.g. Cael) while the selector displayed Derke.
Root cause: the playable-roster filter removed the selected off-roster option, so the browser silently showed the next actor without firing change, leaving each app's backend on the hidden actor.
The roster filter now fires the app's own change path when it removes the selected option, so the backend follows the visible selector.
No prices, stock, balance, credits, chrome data, or world documents changed.
